overview: Dyna-Mind is a two-stage training framework that teaches (V)LM agents to simulate future states from real experience, using RESIM to construct simulation-guided reasoning traces from search trees and Dyna-GRPO to refine simulation ability via online RL with outcome rewards and intermediate state feedback.

modules.name: Environment Interface & Interaction Wrapper
modules.description: Unified environment interface for Sokoban, ALFWorld, and AndroidWorld, handling state observation parsing, action execution, reward computation, and episode termination detection across all benchmarks.

modules.name: Search Tree Construction via DFS
modules.description: Implements depth-first search expansion from a given state using a rollout policy, generating multiple trajectory branches up to a specified depth with real environment interactions for RESIM data collection.

modules.name: Value Estimation for Partial Rollouts
modules.description: Evaluates the quality of partial trajectories from the search tree using either a finetuned value model or LLM-as-a-judge, providing discounted success rate estimates for trajectory selection and ranking.

modules.name: Search Tree Aggregation into Reasoning Traces
modules.description: Converts expanded search trees with value annotations into single coherent reasoning responses by prompting a (V)LM to independently summarize each partial rollout and then aggregate them into simulation-guided reasoning with explicit planning and action selection.

modules.name: RESIM Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the full RESIM inference process: iterative rollout generation, value estimation, top-k trajectory selection, aggregation into aRESIM responses, action execution, and trajectory collection until task completion or max steps.

modules.name: Stage 1 SFT Data Construction & Distillation
modules.description: Constructs supervised fine-tuning data from RESIM-generated trajectories, formatting each state and history context with the corresponding aRESIM response as the training target to teach simulation-guided reasoning without algorithm support.

modules.name: SimRollout Procedure
modules.description: Generates refined responses by extracting planned actions from an initial response, executing them in the environment to obtain ground-truth future states, and then prompting the model to refine its reasoning using this real future-state feedback.

modules.name: Dyna-GRPO Advantage Computation
modules.description: Computes both standard GRPO episode-level advantages from group rewards and the modified Arefine advantage that rewards refined trajectories which are both correct and outperform mean rewards from standard policy and SimRollout rollouts.

modules.name: Dyna-GRPO Training Loop
modules.description: Implements the alternating training procedure between simulation improvement (using SimRollout trajectories with future-state info and refined trajectories) and policy improvement (using standard rollouts), with KL-regularized GRPO optimization in each phase.

modules.name: Simulation Score Evaluation
modules.description: Measures simulation ability by extracting action plans and imagined next-states from model responses, executing plans in the environment to get ground-truth states, and using LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate correctness and progress of simulated states against reality.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Runner
modules.description: Orchestrates evaluation across Sokoban (ID/OOD with different grid sizes), ALFWorld (ID/OOD splits), and AndroidWorld (ID/OOD task types), computing success rates with statistical significance over multiple runs.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Supports controlled ablation experiments including DFS vs BFS search, removal of search tree, removal of Arefine advantage, removal of SimRollout, and comparison against alternative RL algorithms (RLOO, standard GRPO) and baselines (ReACT, Dyna-Think).

modules.name: Baseline Method Implementations
modules.description: Implements comparison methods including ReACT prompting, DeepSeek-R1/V3 direct inference, Dyna-Think (DIT+DDT), simple distillation from various teacher models, and standard RL methods (RLOO, GRPO) for controlled experimental comparisons.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration & Result Reporting
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations for different environments and training stages, tracks training metrics and evaluation results, and generates formatted result tables with success rates, simulation scores, correlation coefficients, and token generation statistics.
